text:
Mia: seeing sustained GPU errors in eu-west-2 (g4dn pool). p95 token latency spiking and queue-depth up 3x. Need immediate redistribution to avoid client errors. Proposing: lower eu-west weight to 0.2, shift to na-west primary, use sa-east as secondary for low-prio jobs. Thoughts?

Ashwin: ack — agree. Also we should preserve Dedicated/reserved pools for enterprise tenants (don't spill them). Use routing policy `latency_then_cost` so we prefer na if latency difference <30ms.

Becky: on it. I'll prepare a policy change and a temporary throttle for non-critical batch jobs. Suggest lowering `burst_factor` to 0.3 for eu-west to reduce token pressure.

Jae: running redispatch script now: 
```
./scripts/gslb/redispatch --set eu-west-2=0.2,na-west-1=0.65,sa-east-1=0.15 --preserve-dedicated=true --dry-run=false
```
ETA ~30s for API push. Watching healthchecks.

Kellen: do NOT increase health-check window beyond 2s — we already saw flapping when that happened last month. Stick to active checks, just lower weight. Also confirm KV-cache affinity preserved for chat sessions.

ops-bot: alert: 12 nodes in eu-west-2 reporting `CUDA_INFER_ERROR` in last 5m. Cluster controller set degraded flag on pool `eu-west-2-g4dn`.

Jae: push done at 1778880120. deploy-bot confirms: 
```
deploy-bot: gslb:weights updated by Jae
- eu-west-2: 0.2
- na-west-1: 0.65
- sa-east-1: 0.15
policy: latency_then_cost (fallback enabled)
preserve_dedicated: true
```

Becky: I've also applied `burst_factor: 0.3` to the eu-west inference-configs and added a temporary rule to deprioritize non-billable evaluation jobs.

Ashwin: good. tradeoff note for finance: cross-region egress will increase for NA->EU failover — estimate +$3.2k/day if traffic stays shifted. But better than errors. I'll log a billing ticket.

Mia: monitoring panels: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/gpu-pools/eu-west-2 and https://grafana.redwood.example/d/gslb/latency-by-region — p95 in na-west dropping to 140ms, errors in eu-west dropping. Keep observing for 15m.

Kellen: also watch KV cache hit-rate for chat sessions, we might see a temporary drop; consider enabling per-user sticky fallback for high-coherence sessions.

Becky: started a targeted throttling job for legacy batch queues (job_id=rb-2026-03-18-07). That should free ~18% capacity.

Jae: healthchecks flipping less now. 3 nodes still returning errors, autoscaler has queued replacements.

ops-bot: autoscaler: 3 replacement nodes provisioning in eu-west-2 (ETA 4m).

Mia: if p95 stays <160ms and error-rate <0.5% in 20m we revert weights to normal gradually (0.6/0.3/0.1). Manual rollback only.

Ashwin: tagging config change with incident=INC-2026-134 and cost-impact=high-transient. I'll open a short post-incident note.

Becky: can someone verify that Dedicated reserved pools were not impacted? I checked the reservation table — looks intact.

Kellen: confirmed reserved_pools unchanged. Good call on preserve_dedicated.

Mia: thanks all. I'll circle back with final state once autoscaler finishes and we run a gentle ramp-down of the reroute. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: gslb:rollback-guard set to 15m — automatic rollback disabled for this change.

Jae: last check at 1778880360: p95 na-west 135ms, eu-west error-rate 0.42%, replacements healthy. Leaving monitor on.

Mia: closing thread for now, will update when we restore normal weighting.
